globalAttributes.name: s-bind
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Two-way data binding. Connects an element to a store variable. Works with text inputs, checkboxes, radios, selects, ranges, color pickers, date inputs, contenteditable, and display elements. ```html

Hello, {name}!

```

globalAttributes.name: s-text
globalAttributes.description: **SensibleJS** — Safe text content. Sets `textContent` from an expression. HTML is escaped. ```html ```

globalAttributes.name: s-html
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Raw HTML content. Sets `innerHTML` from an expression. Only use with trusted content. ```html
```

globalAttributes.name: s-if
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Conditional rendering. Shows or hides elements based on an expression. Preserves the element's original `display` value (flex, grid, inline, etc.). ```html
Welcome back!
{items.length} items
```

globalAttributes.name: s-for
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — List rendering. Iterates over arrays with keyed reconciliation. Use with `s-key` for efficient DOM updates. ```html
{item.name}
``` The loop variable and `index` (0-based) are available inside the loop.

globalAttributes.name: s-key
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — List item key. Tells `s-for` how to identify each item for efficient DOM reconciliation. ```html
...
```

globalAttributes.name: s-click
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Click handler.

Executes an expression when the element is clicked. Works inside `s-for` with access to the loop variable.

```html
<button s-click="count++">Increment</button>
<button s-click="items.removeWhere('id', item.id)">Delete</button>
```

globalAttributes.name: s-unclick
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Click outside handler. Fires when a click occurs outside the element. Useful for closing dropdowns and modals. ```html
Menu content
```

globalAttributes.name: s-on
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — General event binding.

Format: `event.modifier: expression`. Multiple bindings separated by semicolons.

Modifiers: `.prevent`, `.stop`, `.enter`, `.escape`

```html
<input s-on="keydown.enter: submitForm()">
<form s-on="submit.prevent: handleSubmit()">
```

globalAttributes.name: s-class
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Conditional CSS classes. Semicolon-separated `className: expression` pairs. ```html
...
```

globalAttributes.name: s-css
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Dynamic inline styles. Semicolon-separated `property: expression` pairs. Supports `{template}` expressions. ```html
...
```

globalAttributes.name: s-attr
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Dynamic HTML attributes.

Semicolon-separated `attribute: expression` pairs. `false`/`null`/`undefined` removes the attribute, `true` sets it as empty.

```html
<button s-attr="disabled: !formValid">Submit</button>
```

globalAttributes.name: s-ref
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Element reference.

Names an element so it can be accessed via `$refs.name` in expressions.

```html
<input type="text" s-ref="myInput">
<button s-click="$refs.myInput.focus()">Focus</button>
```

globalAttributes.name: s-cloak
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Hide until ready.

Prevents flash of unprocessed template expressions. Removed automatically after init.

```html
<body s-cloak>...</body>
```

globalAttributes.name: s-data
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Inline variable definition. Define variables directly in HTML without a store. ```html
```

globalAttributes.name: s-debounce
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Debounced input.

Delay updates on text inputs until typing stops. Value in milliseconds.

```html
<input s-bind="search" s-debounce="300">
```

globalAttributes.name: s-blur
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — Update on blur.

Switch text input binding from `keyup` to `blur` event.

```html
<input s-bind="tagline" s-blur>
```

globalAttributes.name: s-transition
globalAttributes.description:
**SensibleJS** — CSS transition animations. Animate `s-if` show/hide and `s-for` enter/leave. Applies CSS class lifecycle: `{name}-enter` → `{name}-enter-active` → `{name}-enter-to`. ```html
Animated
```

globalAttributes.name: s-src
globalAttributes.description: **SensibleJS** — Dynamic image source. For images inside `s-for` loops. Uses template syntax. ```html ```
